newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Zedillo sees sustainable growth from 1998.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Zedillo sees sustainable growth from 1998.

text.p: President Ernesto Zedillo said on Tuesday that Mexico will start to show sustainable economic growth from next year.
"Now we have the solid base to transform the economic recovery into a process of sustained growth, sustainable from 1998 onwards," he said.
He said that Monday's first quarter numbers for gross domestic product, showing growth a little over five percent, confirmed that the recovery which began in 1996 would be maintained in 1997.
Me made the comments in a speech on water supply in the Mexico City region in which he referred to the economic emergency Mexico underwent shortly after he took office.
